title: Choosing a Digital Tool for a Specific User
instructions: 阅读短文，完成8个题目。注意：本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思试题。先读题，再读文章。答案必须来自文章。
passage:
A. Mei is a Chinese adult learner. She wants to choose a digital tool for her father. Her father is 68 years old. He lives in a small town. He wants to learn English for travel. He has a smartphone, but he does not like small buttons. He needs a simple tool.

B. Mei compares three apps. The first app is very popular. It has many lessons. But the lessons are long. Her father gets tired after 20 minutes. The second app is for children. It has bright colors and games. Her father feels strange using it. The third app is new. It has short lessons. Each lesson is 10 minutes. The app also has a big button for listening. Her father can press it easily.

C. Mei reads reviews. One review says, "The short lessons are good for old users." Another review says, "The app is free, but it has ads." Mei's father does not like ads. Mei finds a setting to remove ads. It costs 20 yuan each month. Her father agrees to pay. He says, "I want to learn to speak English for my trip." Mei helps him download the app. Now her father uses it every day. He listens to English for 10 minutes. Then he repeats the sentences. He is happy because the tool is easy to use.

grammar.title: 表目的；动词后接 to do / doing；基础被动语态入门
grammar.explanation: 1. 表目的：用 to + 动词原形表示“为了做某事”。例如：He wants to learn English for travel.（to learn 表示目的）2. 动词后接 to do 或 doing：有些动词后常接 to do，如 want, need, agree, help；有些动词后常接 doing，如 like, enjoy, finish。注意：like 后也可接 to do，但本课先练常见搭配。3. 基础被动语态：be + 过去分词，表示“被……”。例如：The app is used by many people.（is used 表示被动）
grammar.example: He wants to learn English for travel.

questions.explanation: want 后接 to do，表示想要做某事。
questions.evidence: He wants to learn English for travel.

questions.explanation: need 后接 to do，表示需要做某事。
agree 后接 to do，表示同意做某事。
enjoy 后接 doing，表示喜欢做某事。
questions.evidence: He listens to English for 10 minutes.

questions.explanation: finish 后接 doing，表示完成做某事。
被动语态：be + 过去分词，表示“被使用”。
questions.evidence: Now her father uses it every day.

questions.explanation: 被动语态：are + 过去分词，表示“被完成”。
